name: TextHalu-Bench
description: A text benchmark that focuses on hallucination-related phenomena in language model outputs, assessing models' tendency to generate inaccurate or fabricated information and their ability to detect or avoid such hallucinations. It contains tasks for evaluating both generation quality and hallucination detection/classification. Useful for research on safety, factuality, and trustworthiness of text generation systems.
reputation: A recently published dataset with modest uptake among researchers studying hallucination and factuality in LLM outputs.
